description: Grade distributions from PlanetTerp for a course, a professor, or both, broken down by section. At least one of course or professor is required; semester and section narrow the result. No login needed.

course.description: Only include grades for this course, e.g. "MATH140"

professor.description: Only include grades for sections taught by this professor, e.g. "Jon Snow"

section.description: Only include this section, e.g. "101" or "0101" (default: all sections)

semester.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

name: planetterp_get_grades

grades.description: One entry per section matching the query

A.description: Number of students in the section who received an A

A+.description: Number of students in the section who received an A+

A-.description: Number of students in the section who received an A-

B.description: Number of students in the section who received a B

B+.description: Number of students in the section who received a B+

B-.description: Number of students in the section who received a B-

C.description: Number of students in the section who received a C

C+.description: Number of students in the section who received a C+

C-.description: Number of students in the section who received a C-

D.description: Number of students in the section who received a D

D+.description: Number of students in the section who received a D+

D-.description: Number of students in the section who received a D-

F.description: Number of students in the section who received an F

Other.description: Number of students in the section who received some other grade, e.g. pass/fail or incomplete

W.description: Number of students in the section who received a W (withdrew)

professor.description: Name of the professor who taught the section

section.description: Section number as PlanetTerp records it, without leading zeros, e.g. "101" for 0101

semester.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

title: Get grades
